scenes.prompt: Early evening in a French home: a mother just back from work, coat still on, slumps on the hallway bench with her bag dropped on the floor and a comically exhausted face, while two children aged 7 and 9 jump excitedly in front of her holding a board game and a toy sword.

In the evening, a tired French father sits on a sofa next to a laundry basket and a closed laptop, staring at the ceiling with a comically empty, drained face, while two children aged 7 and 9 sit in front of him with hopeful expectant eyes, warm lamp light, a cat asleep.

A relaxed smiling French mother sits on a sofa holding a smartphone with a blank screen, while two children aged 7 and 9 already wearing cardboard knight armor, a golden paper crown and a helmet with a red plume cheer around her, warm lamp light.

In a sunny Alsatian village square with half-timbered houses, a smiling parent reads from a smartphone with a blank screen while children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet run toward a stone fountain to look for a hidden clue, one with a magnifying glass.

A big happy family group of children aged 7 to 10, siblings and cousins dressed as knights with crowns and red plumed helmets, cheer together in a flowery Alsatian street with half-timbered houses, golden hour light.
